findings.observation: Yu NPC article links The Monks Of Shang Village among quests given and Report To Officer Yu among quests handed in. The quest dialogue labels Yu for offering, carrying and finishing, attributed to Fandom by the archive. Agreement is internal archive cross-reference, not independent corroboration.

Yu details retain level 25, five dots and Type Report To Officer Yu literally. Type is an anomalous quest-like label, not a verified creature classification. Quest level 2 describes the quest, not the NPC. Detail location 10195, -6661, 2185 and map label 05 at 9912, 2115 remain separate coordinate contexts.

Shaof NPC article links The Ra'Jin Grand Master among quests given. Quest offering text names Grand Master Shaof and is attributed to an in-game photograph by the archive operator. NPC level 25 and two dots are separate from quest level 10 and Nahuji target claims. Ghost race is only a literal NPC-page field.

Master Fhungusu NPC article preserves a first-person warning about following orders and slaying innocent people. Archive says Read off the screen in game. No fan site recorded these. This is archive attribution, not independently inspected screenshot evidence. Yu quest links named Master Fhungusu are quest URLs, not proof that they identify this mob record.

Map spot labels and coordinates remain article contexts, not exact authoritative spawns. No loot recorded is absence of archive records, not proof of zero drops. Quest reward sections are not death loot.
